what: Every page as a visitor, a student, a graduated student, two faculty members (one not accepting inquiries), a faculty member who has left, and staff, at 390 x 844 (phone width) in headless Chrome, on `npm run dev:local -- --scale` (R1 to Final fixtures plus the scale fixture). Each page's 'Show more' was pressed and every <details> opened before checking.
checks: axe-core 4.10.2 (WCAG 2.0/2.1 A and AA, plus best practice); horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth vs clientWidth); page errors, console errors and server 5xx responses.
firstRun: Two moderate axe findings from the redesign: the simulated-date notice sat outside every landmark (region, on every page), and the home page's Open now box was an <aside> inside <main> (landmark-complementary-is-top-level). Both fixed.
